- Fixed SQL injection in `PDO::lastInsertId($name)` (CWE-89). The sequence-name lookup in `pdo_sqlsrv_dbh_last_id` previously interpolated the caller-supplied `$name` directly into the query text with `snprintf` (`WHERE name=N'%s'`), allowing a crafted name to break out of the string literal and inject arbitrary Transact-SQL. ### Fixed
- Browsing a note no longer modifies it, and external edits are preserved when the view is closed.
Maintenance release with no user-facing changes.

### Improved

- Link and image detection is faster in long text fields.

### Fixed

- Edits made while a save is in progress are now preserved.

- Remove Convex DB's separate table and row lattices; its components now merge their own data. ([Merge Policy](convex-db/docs/LATTICE-DB-ARCHITECTURE.md#merge-policy))
- Support PostgreSQL client transactions and more standard SQL in Convex DB (from @trsb-standards). ([#812](https://github.com/Convex-Dev/convex/issues/812))
- Secure Convex DB's PostgreSQL connections with TLS (proposed by @trsb-standards). ([TLS](convex-db/README.md#tls))
- Keep each application's Convex DB connections on its own database.

- Improve robustness of shutdown and persistence for lattice services, P2P nodes, DLFS and JDBC file databases.
- Improve PostgreSQL wire protocol handling in Convex DB.

- More reliable Etch collection, caching and lattice state persistence. ([GC](https://github.com/Convex-Dev/convex/issues/746), [caching](https://github.com/Convex-Dev/convex/commit/08fe97d8d), [state](https://github.com/Convex-Dev/convex/commit/1dbc4896c))
- Accurate PostgreSQL cast and operator handling in Convex DB. ([Details](https://github.com/Convex-Dev/convex/commit/0c3a4db53))

### Added

- P2P nodes can advertise Point of Presence node keys and explicit relay
  willingness in signed NodeInfo. Opt-in PoP nodes forward bounded end-to-end
  signed messages over authenticated routes; outbound-only nodes can exchange
  public values or ECIES-encrypted private values through a shared PoP.
- P2P lattice nodes can bootstrap from one authenticated node key and TCP address.
  The connecting node pushes only its own signed NodeInfo entry, allowing the remote
  node to challenge it on the sa

- Convex DB components now retain their containing application-policy hierarchy, so nested table persistence reaches a hosted `RootComponent` without moving cursors and database/schema forks keep the same persistence policy while synchronising only to their original cursor (#698).

### Changed

- The default client transaction timeout is raised from 8 to 20 seconds, so ordinary scheduling delay on a loaded machine no longer surfaces as a spurious `:TIMEOUT` result. Connection establishment and internal queue backpressure keep the previous 8 second bound under the new `Config.DEFAULT_INTERNAL_TIMEOUT`.
- `LatticeContext` is now an extensible application policy: timestamps and signing can be resolved dynamically after one root installation, and delegated overrides replace individual cap

### Added

- Lattice applications compose local or NodeServer-hosted component trees through `ALatticeApplication`, with multi-owner DLFS applications, per-owner drives and temporary forks, and the same host-neutral stack in P2P.
- Standalone `convex.dlfs.Main` boots a complete NodeServer-hosted DLFS without the Convex CLI, configured in JSON5 for storage, identity, bootstrap peers, HTTP limits and exposure policy.
- CVM: `char?` type predicate for Character values (v1 protocol, #92).
- DLFS exposes its can

### Added

- Ed25519 JWT signing accepts explicit verification-method key IDs, while self-contained verification recognises bare multikey, `did:key` and multikey-fragment DID URL forms.
- Lattice propagators can own filtered outbound views, preserving store-local refs and complete pending inbound merges while excluding filtered cells from announced roots across startup, replication, restore and shutdown.
- Lattice nodes can pull and merge a selected cursor path without transferring unrelated sibling regions

- **MariaDB Sequence Group**: Added a dedicated "Sequences" object group under MariaDB database nodes for intuitive sequence browsing and management.
- **openGauss & GaussDB Compatibility Fixes**:
- **MariaDB 序列分组支持**：MariaDB 数据库节点下新增「序列 (Sequences)」独立对象分组，便于直观浏览与管理序列。
- PostgreSQL 族聚合函数严格按聚合元数据登记归类，仅出现在「聚合函数」分组，不再与普通函数重复混杂。
- **openGauss / GaussDB

- **Doris Expansion Fix Without Active Backends**: Fixed an issue where expanding a Doris database failed when only frontends (FE) were active without available Backends (BE); added smooth fallback to ensure tables and views are listed reliably.

- PostgreSQL: Added foreign tables, aggregate functions, and indexes under schemas; added extensions, event triggers, tablespaces, foreign data wrappers (FDW), and foreign servers under databases.
- SQL Server: Added foreign tables, indexes, sequences, synonyms, triggers, and user-defined types (UDT) under schemas, plus database triggers under databases; expanding routines now details parameters and return types.
- **ClickHouse System Functions Group**: Added a functions group under ClickHouse database node

本轮改进 AI 对完整诉求的理解和对话衔接，保持既有业务确认与领域校验。

- 复合目标、否定和更正优先进入语义判断，修复状态查询提前截走办理要求的问题。
- 悬浮助手传递页面路径和链接中的明确业务编码，减少重复说明对象。
- 失败重试沿用原对象线索，避免切换页面后改变同一请求的目标。
- 过滤无效历史角色与空消息，避免重复发送当前问题。
- 知识引用测试使用自带合

- Added [English setup instructions](https://github.com/han139242/ai-mes-copilot/blob/v1.0.2/docs/SETUP.en.md), including database migration order, environment variables, model configuration, and common startup problems.
The release ZIP is a source snapshot. SHA256SUMS.txt records its checksum. Use your own isolated database and backend model-service configuration.
